paragraphs: IQGeo gives telecom and utility operators a single platform to plan, design, build, and operate their physical network infrastructure. It is aimed at telecom, fiber, and utility network operators, including planners, engineers, and construction teams.

Network Manager Telecom is built to plan, build, and operate fiber and coax networks with accurate data, simple field tools, and automated AI quality checks. Field staff can download their work area, update records offline, and sync changes back automatically. Construction photos are audited with real-time visual AI to verify quality, completeness, and compliance at scale. A companion product, Network Manager Electric, is described as built for geospatial work execution, combining geospatial intelligence with AI-powered workflows across the full lifecycle.

Buyers choose between two deployment options, an IQGeo SaaS deployment or a private cloud deployment they host themselves. The hosted option is listed with ISO/IEC 27001:2013 certification. The private cloud option is pitched at operators needing bespoke integration with legacy GIS and OSS/BSS systems. The company says electric and gas utilities rely on it for asset management, grid modernization, inspection and field operations. On the telecom side it describes its customers as reaching some of the largest and fastest-growing global telecom operators, managing highly complex, rapidly scaling networks.

quote.text: IQGeo gives telecom and utility operators a single, end-to-end platform to plan, design, build, and operate their physical network infrastructure.
